{{Otheruses|staff}}
'''Staff officer''' was a term given to military [[Officer/Legends|officers]]; whereas [[line officer]]s were given command of field units, staff officers were commissioned based on their own area of specialisation. These specialist roles included [[Scientist/Legends|scientists]], [[Doctor/Legends|doctors]], [[Lawyer/Legends|laywers]], and other non-combat roles. Although staff officers were fully capable officers within their field, and had all the rights and privileges of their rank, they often lacked the leadership and tactical skills of line officers.<ref name="GAW">''[[Galaxy at War]]''</ref>

In the [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial Military]], staff officers were present in military formations in the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]] from the [[Company/Legends|company]] level and above. These staff officers fulfilled the positions of formation second-in-command, [[Logistics officer/Legends|logistics officer]], [[Chief medical officer|medical officer]], [[technical officer]], and [[headquarters officer]]. The [[Military rank/Legends|rank]] of the staff officers varied depending on the size of the formation; staff officers assigned to a company-level unit would hold the rank of [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]], while an equivalent staff officer in a [[Battle group/Legends|battle group]] holding the rank of [[Major/Legends|major]].<ref name="ISB">''[[Imperial Sourcebook]]''</ref>

Staff officers were also used by the Empire as positions within [[Garrison/Legends|garrisons]] commands. The [[Major General]] in charge of the base was assisted by five staff officers at the rank of [[High Colonel/Legends|High Colonel]]. Each staff officer was assisted by a sub-staff officer with the rank of [[Lieutenant Colonel/Legends|Lieutenant Colonel]].<ref name="IG">{{JournalCite|12|Imperial Garrisons}}</ref>
